cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Raise the Stakes
cards.instruction: Persuade them to accept a larger risk, cost, or commitment so the outcome will feel decisive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you put your club captaincy on the rematch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For one week, then. If I lose, I'll clean everyone's kit for that week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can't even remember who won the last six. Your captaincy against my kit duty, for one week. Shake?
